learn.hook: Nani wants to sew a lace border all around her quilt. How much lace does she need? That length is the perimeter!
points: Perimeter is the total length of the boundary (the edge all around) of a shape.
To find it, add the lengths of all the sides.
Rectangle: perimeter = length + breadth + length + breadth = 2 × (length + breadth).
Square: all 4 sides are equal, so perimeter = 4 × side.
Perimeter is measured in units of length: cm, m or km.

learn.hook: Try to cover your desk with bangles. Now try with notebooks. Which one leaves gaps?
points: Shapes that cover a surface with no gaps and no overlaps tile it. Squares, rectangles and triangles can; circles always leave gaps.
We can measure a table's area using any tile as the unit: squares, rectangles or triangles.
Two matching triangles (half squares) make one square. So 12 squares = 24 triangles.
A rectangle made of 2 squares is a bigger unit: 12 squares = 6 such rectangles.
